name: Blessed Bolts
description: Consecrated bolts prepared for use in rites of sanctioned violence against profane or corrupted threats.
narrative_effects: Supports sacred-pressure framing where holy authority is recognized and relevant.
Typically treated as ritually expended whether physically recoverable or not.

mechanical_effect.trigger: fired from a compatible crossbow in sanctioned violence against a profane, corrupted, undead, or sacredly vulnerable threat where holy authority is recognized and relevant
mechanical_effect.applies_to: attack or pressure checks where the bolt's consecration can matter against profane, corrupted, undead, or oath-hostile entities
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: ordinary targets with no sacred vulnerability; non-combat social authority checks; attacks where the bolt is not fired from a compatible crossbow
